title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 2.2 Linear Equations in One Variable: Solve equations in one variable algebraically.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 2.2 Linear Equations in One Variable: Solve equations in one variable algebraically.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "2.2 Linear Equations in One Variable", prints these objectives: "Solve equations in one variable algebraically." "Solve a rational equation." "Find a linear equation." "Given the equations of two lines, determine whether their graphs are parallel or perpendicular." "Write the equation of a line parallel or perpendicular to a given line.". The section text says: "Caroline is a full-time college student planning a spring break vacation. To earn enough money for the trip, she has taken a part-time job at the local bank that pays $15.00/hr, and she opened a savings account with an initial deposit of $400 on January 15. She arranged for direct deposit of her payroll checks. If spring break begins March 20 and the trip will cost approximately $2,500, how many hours will she have to work to earn enough to pay for her vacation? If she can only work 4 hours per…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
